title: "Like a Circle, Has No End": The Judge Who Sentenced Billy McFarland

lines.say: October eleventh, two thousand eighteen. Billy McFarland stands for sentencing on five counts.
lines.show: October 11, 2018. Billy McFarland stands for sentencing on five counts.

lines.say: His defense described a young man with a flawed business plan. Judge Naomi Reice Buchwald disagreed.

scene.q: Importantly, this was not a good idea gone bad.

lines.say: While raising money for the festival, she noted, he moved from an eight thousand dollar a month apartment to a twenty-one thousand dollar a month penthouse.
lines.show: While raising money for the festival, she noted, he moved from an $8,000-a-month apartment to a $21,000-a-month penthouse.

scene.src: Gov't sentencing memo, S.D.N.Y., Oct 3, 2018 · Sentencing transcript, Oct 11, 2018

lines.say: After his second arrest, he had also lied to a federal agent. The judge's words: white-collar obstruction.

scene.q: the defendant is a serial fraudster, and that to date his fraud, like a circle, has no end.

lines.say: Six years in prison, and a forfeiture of twenty-six point one nine million dollars.
lines.show: Six years in prison, and a forfeiture of $26.19 million.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
